notes: Day End is now gated by the user privilege. The Exit/DayEnd button is hidden from any role that does not have the Day End Process privilege, and it appears or disappears within a minute of the privilege being changed on the server - no logout needed. If the handler is reached any other way it refuses and names the role instead of showing a plain exit prompt, which previously made a revoked privilege look identical to no gating at all. Roles without the privilege still leave the POS via Logout or the window close button.
